name: SoilGrids
tagline: Global soil property maps via REST for precision-ag planning
description: SoilGrids is ISRIC's global digital soil-mapping system, providing modeled soil-property maps at 250 m resolution across six standard depth intervals, with quantified prediction uncertainty. Its beta REST API v2.0 is currently paused with no estimated restoration date; ISRIC recommends WMS, WCS, WebDAV, or Google Earth Engine for current access.

auth.details: No authentication required for the public REST endpoints; requests are made directly without API keys or OAuth.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Publicly accessible under CC BY 4.0, but the REST API is currently paused. When available, fair use is limited to 5 API calls per 1-minute period.

rate_limits: 5 API calls per 1-minute period under the Fair Use Policy; the REST API is currently paused.
use_cases: get soil pH at a farm field lat/lon
fetch clay/silt/sand texture fractions for a plot
retrieve soil organic carbon stock for a depth interval
sample bulk density and related properties for site suitability
batch-query soil layers for precision-ag planning polygons (via multiple point queries)
